purpose: Measure sequential remote KV failure detection, persistent-client recovery, and failed-put residue clearance during a reversible client-to-Master path fault.
claim_boundary: Single-client sequential recovery from a short client-to-Master TCP fault. Controller completion does not imply every trial passed: the sole tolerated per-trial product failure is initial failed-put residue beyond 15 seconds, and only when the post-client-close audit is complete, remains unreadable with zero COMPLETE replicas, and clears within its separate 15-second deadline. Not HA, serving, NoF data-path failure, target failure, or true concurrency.
